turns.reply:
I solved level 1 of task-5f650ec8 in 94 actions. The human baseline is 78, so I used 16 more actions than the baseline.

How the game works:
- Each move shifts the block 6 cells.
- The small 8-colored square at the top right is a switch. The 8-colored gate stays open only while a block stands on the switch.
- Action 5 restarts the level. A copy of the block then repeats your moves from the last run, one step for each new move you make.

The winning plan: move right 4 times to reach the switch, then press 5. In the new run, the copy goes back to the switch and holds the gate open. At the same time, you move down 7 and right 4 or 5 to reach the goal. That is about 17 actions.

Most of my actions went into finding this out. My first guess was wrong: I thought the 9-colored copy stayed in place, but I was the one controlling it.

I saved these notes as a global memory for later levels and future runs of this game. The first two save attempts failed because of wrong argument names. The third call worked, although it gave an error at the end.
